liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer notes a pretty good flub during Bird Song [19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Touch Of Grey into Estimated Prophet is singled out as downright awesome [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-10-13.sbd.wiley.11627.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 142 min [1]. Said about its sound: Noticeable hiss, but tolerable; Cold Rain & Snow fades in with its first notes clipped [1]
- **gd1990-10-13.aud.holtz.GEMS.92841.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 143 min [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has sporadic over-saturation in the vocals, as the raw tapes ran very hot; attenuated somewhat [3]
- **gd1990-10-13.141086.sbd.miller.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd90-10-13.dsbd.hinko.21971.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 144 min; rated 2.45/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording's sound quality superb [14]

## Around the show

- Opening night of the European tour; a rumor says the band flew in from the West Coast days earlier and had jetlag [9]
- Reviewer flew over on a plane full of Deadheads who partied throughout the flight [10]
- Cold hockey arena with carpet laid over ice, ice showing through; taper batteries froze in the pit [10]
- Reviewer was busted by Swedish police but not fined or arrested [11]
- Reviewer recalls Bob Weir joking that a Swedish group called jetlag had replaced the band [13]
- Phil blurts out 'Thanks Mom' after the encore, and Bobby says 'Ice Rink' during One More Saturday Night [14]
- Reviewer recalls apologizing to Swedes for American foreign policy of the time [16]
- A book reportedly says Jerry was given a pot cookie beforehand and struggled to play [19]
- Reviewer says the band sounds flat and un-together here, missing Hornsby, though Jerry seems in good spirits [9]
- Reviewer says the band played nowhere near as well as later in the tour [11]
- Not the band's worst; reviewer points to the MSG run and Paris shows as far better [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-10-13.sbd.wiley.11627.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MC>C>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: A dropout at a cassette flip during Space was removed; The Promised Land cuts in after a removed dropout [1]
- **gd1990-10-13.aud.holtz.GEMS.92841.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by Brian Green; Evan K.; source: Unknown Mics > Sony D-5 [3]. Also: Greg lent his d5 to friends to tape these shows in exchange for masters; the rigs are unknown [3]
- **gd1990-10-13.141086.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make the soundboard complete, with pitch correction applied; Patch source came from Alf Houck, Robert Wright and Bill Koucky [4]
- **gd90-10-13.dsbd.hinko.21971.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Richard A. Cummings Grateful: [1990-10-13 Ice Stadium, Stockholm, Sweden - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-10-13-ice-stadium-stockholm-sweden/) [22]
